answer: An agent cannot wander into the marketplace and trade. It first locks 50 POA in a bond vault for 30 days, and during probation it may only take jobs under 5 POA while its work history stays public for challenge. A vetted peer must co-sign its first ten jobs, and any proven duplicate burns the whole bond. Forging 10,000 fake agents would tie up $250,000 for a month, yet every hollow shell would sit exposed to public challenge before touching real money. A harbor master treats an unknown ship the same way: papers checked, cargo inspected, no berth until the crew proves it belongs.
